title: Redirecting Iodine Reduction Pathways by Decoupling Adsorption Energies for Long-Life Zn–I2 Batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06963G, Paper
Maoxin Chen, Huan Li, Hui Xu, Zhitan Wu, Jinxing Chen, Huihui Lin, Ao Du, Sundus Umer, Zihui Chen, Ning Yue, Zhijie Yan, Tianyu Yin, Nianjun Yang, Jiong Lu, Weichao Wang, Chunpeng Yang, Quanhong Yang
Zinc–iodine (Zn–I2) batteries are promising for grid-scale energy storage, yet rapid capacity fade from polyiodide shuttling remains a fundamental challenge. This shuttling arises from the coupled, stepwise iodine reduction pathway...
